title: Compact Cycle Pilot: 3-week microcycles, staffing hedge lanes, and scoped auction playbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Run a 3-week microcycle pilot to validate a compact cadence for high-uncertainty initiatives. The pilot includes: a staffed hedge pool (2 FTE-equivalent reserve), a role-anchoring protocol to reduce context switching, and a scoped-auction mechanism for last-minute priority additions. Goal: increase delivered critical-path scope by 15% per cycle without increasing total headcount. Outputs: playbook, decision matrix, and tooling templates for the Console and cycle tracker.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook drafted and reviewed by Eng/Design/PM leads
Pilot run with 3 teams across infra, runtime, and console during 2026-W10 through W12
Measured KPIs: delivered committed scope %, unplanned work %, cycle throughput, and team satisfaction survey
Toolkit: cycle-hedge dashboard with reserve usage and shadowing sign-ups integrated into Cycle Tracker
Recommendation produced: adopt, iterate, or rollback with clear thresholds
